argv:
export MODE=native PORT=30523 MASTER_PORT=29923 SWEEP_ID=20261021_184122-1442878-repeat3

set -euo pipefail

export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=4
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="$PWD"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$PWD/third_party/sglang"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2="$PWD/third_party/flashmla"
export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_3=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_3="$PWD/third_party/flashmla/csrc/cutlass"

export GPUS="${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:?GPUQ did not assign GPUs}"
IFS=, read -r -a allocated <<< "$GPUS"
[ "${#allocated[@]}" -eq 4 ] || {
  echo "Expected four assigned GPUs; got $GPUS"
  exit 1
}

export SGLANG_ROOT_CT="/mnt/host_root$PWD/third_party/sglang"
export SGLANG_PY="$SGLANG_ROOT_CT/python"
export TP=4 MEM_FRAC=0.86 SERVER_SEED=20260919
export CHUNK=8192 MAX_RUN=256 CTX_LEN=1048576
unset C4_KEEP_COUNT C4_LAYER_KEEP_COUNTS STORE_IMPLEMENTATION
unset DECODE_CFG SERVER_PID_FILE_CT
if [ "$MODE" = kernel ]; then
  export C4_KEEP_COUNT=256
fi

export REPLAY_DIR=/home/jovyan/wenyuhong/benchmarks
export REPLAY_DATASET="$REPLAY_DIR/datasets/h20-dsv4pro/longcodebench_openai"
export REPLAY_MANIFEST="$REPLAY_DIR/cache/official-longswebench/longswebench-openai-v1.json"
export REPLAY_RUNNER="$PWD/scripts/local/business_replay/runner.py"
export REPLAY_ADAPTER="$PWD/scripts/local/business_replay/adapters/openai_sse.py"
export REPLAY_SCHEDULER=request-slot-fifo
export REPLAY_SESSION_POPULATION=24
export REPLAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT=120
export REPLAY_TTFT_SLO_MS=10000

export RESULTS_HOST="$PWD/results"
export LOG_HOST="$PWD/logs/${MODE}-mf086-p24-sweep-${SWEEP_ID}"
export REQUEST_METRICS_DIR="$LOG_HOST/request-metrics"
mkdir -p "$LOG_HOST"

python3 scripts/sources.py "$PWD" > "$LOG_HOST/source-manifest.json"
docker inspect "${CONTAINER:-remnant}" --format "{{.Image}}" \
  > "$LOG_HOST/image-id.txt"
printf "%s\n" "$GPUS" > "$LOG_HOST/gpus.txt"
sha256sum scripts/local/serve.sh scripts/local/run-server.sh \
  scripts/local/bench-lswb.sh > "$LOG_HOST/launcher-sha256.txt"

cleanup() {
  rc=$?
  trap - EXIT INT TERM
  bash scripts/local/serve.sh "$MODE" stop || rc=1
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap "exit 130" INT
trap "exit 143" TERM

bash scripts/local/serve.sh "$MODE"

overall_rc=0
shopt -s nullglob

for C in 24; do
  tag="${MODE}-mf086-p24-c${C}-${SWEEP_ID}"
  printf "\nStarting %s\n" "$tag"

  rc=0
  bash scripts/local/bench-lswb.sh "$tag" "$PORT" "$C" 1200 || rc=$?

  runs=("$RESULTS_HOST/lswb-replay/$tag"/20*)
  [ "${#runs[@]}" -gt 0 ] || {
    echo "Missing result directory for $tag"
    exit 1
  }
  run="${runs[${#runs[@]}-1]}"

  mkdir -p "$run/server"
  cp "$LOG_HOST/serve_${MODE}.log" \
     "$LOG_HOST/source-manifest.json" \
     "$LOG_HOST/image-id.txt" \
     "$LOG_HOST/gpus.txt" \
     "$LOG_HOST/launcher-sha256.txt" "$run/server/"

  python3 - "$run" "$rc" "$C" "$MODE" <<"PY_VALIDATE"
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
rc, concurrency = int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
mode = sys.argv[4]

def read(name):
    path = root / name
    if not path.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"Incomplete cell: missing {path}")
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

done = read("client/done.json")
summary = read("client/summary.json")
manifest = read("client/manifest.json")
timing = read("request-timing-validation.json")
server = read("server-info.json")

protocol = "business-request-slot-replay-v1"
if any(x.get("protocol") != protocol for x in (done, summary, manifest)):
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: wrong replay protocol")
replay = manifest["replay"]
if (replay["session_population"], replay["max_concurrency"],
        replay["max_duration_s"]) != (24, concurrency, 1200):
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: wrong population, concurrency or window")
if server["mem_fraction_static"] != 0.86 or server["tp_size"] != 4:
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: wrong memory fraction or TP")
expected_format = "native" if mode == "native" else "remnant"
if server["dsv4_c4_cache_format"] != expected_format:
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: wrong cache format")
if not timing.get("complete") or summary.get("instrumentation_errors"):
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: timing collection or instrumentation failed")
if rc != 0 and summary["valid"]:
    raise SystemExit(f"{root}: unexpected launcher failure, rc={rc}")

print("Cell complete:",
      "valid=", summary["valid"],
      "SLO=", summary["slo"]["status"],
      "req/s=", summary["request_throughput"])
PY_VALIDATE

  bash scripts/local/lswb-row.sh "$run"
  printf "Results: %s\n" "$run"

  [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || overall_rc=1
done

exit "$overall_rc"
